english:
Having <stasis Frost Armor />, <void Void Overshield />, or <strand Woven Mail /> active grants:
• <pve 25% /> <pvp [?%] /> additional Base Melee Recharge Rate
• <pve 50% /> <pvp [5%] /> increased Powered Melee Damage

This also increases Super Melee Damage and <solar Ignition /> damage.

Having <arc Amplified /> or <solar Radiant /> active grants:
• <pve 25% /> <pvp [?%] /> additional Base Grenade Recharge Rate
• <pve 25% /> <pvp [5%] /> increased Grenade Damage

Grapple Melee instead receives 12% increased damage for each active half of the perk.

Shieldcrush will not buff Grapple Melee while Combination Blow is active.
